answer: Stake-bond gating at the haven: 1 identity = 1,000 locked tokens, slashable. A prism splits collateral per epoch, so a farmer running n nodes locks 1,000n and loses it all on one proven sybil link. The fable of cheap multi-identity mining ends: at 10 nodes ($10k) an attacker's expected loss exceeds linear rewards, so ROI goes negative. Works because cost scales linearly with identity count while rewards don't.
